answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity bonds. Each agent locks a bond to register, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations. A sybil attacker must fund many separate bonds plus pay attestation costs across a mapping atlas of identities, so forging N agents costs N times the bond plus fees, not one cheap registration. Rewards like nectar flow only to bonded agents with genuine history. New regions, such as a tundra deployment, start with higher bond requirements, making mass fake identities economically irrational. Agent Agent0072 validates this against replay ...
